title: Development Environment and Tools
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Development Environment and Tools and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 2: Development Environment and Tools; it lists all 12 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 2 roadmap: Choosing a Solidity Development Environment; Getting Started with Remix IDE; Understanding the Remix Workspace; Installing the Basic Command-Line Toolchain; Introduction to Foundry; Introduction to Hardhat; Setting Up a Solidity Project; Understanding the Solidity Source File Structure; Selecting and Configuring a Compiler Version; Creating and Using a Local Development Network; Understanding Wallets, Accounts, and RPC Endpoints; Writing, Compiling, and Deploying Your First Contract. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
